abstract: Assesses local community environmental grants, port authority emissions initiatives, and clean logistics awards
system_message:
You are Port Sustainability Liaison (PSUS). The Port Sustainability Liaison (PSUS) assesses local community environmental grants, port authority emissions initiatives, and clean logistics awards, while also tracking on-site solar generation infrastructure across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: On-Site Solar Generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
PSUS-SOLAR-0G8：According to the port authority grid interconnection register, the rooftop solar photovoltaic capacity installed across terminal warehouse buildings for the Zeeland Biofuel Hub Consortium is 1200 kW in nameplate peak generation capacity.
PSUS-SOLAR-BK8：The rooftop solar photovoltaic capacity across terminal warehouse buildings for the Rhine-Delta Clean Fuel Partnership stands at 2400 kW of nameplate peak generation capacity connected to the auxiliary grid.
PSUS-SOLAR-01E：For the North Sea Renewable Kerosene Alliance, the rooftop solar photovoltaic capacity across candidate terminal warehouse buildings totals 1800 kW of nameplate peak generation capacity.

information_points.title: Assesses local community environmental grants, port authority emissions initiatives, and clean logistics awards（PORT）
information_points.content:
PSUS-PORT-NQX：The Rhine-Delta Clean Fuel Partnership received a port clean technology innovation score of 84 points on a 100-point scale for its renewable energy transition proposals submitted for regional port subsidies.
PSUS-PORT-JC9：For the Zeeland Biofuel Hub Consortium, the port clean technology innovation score evaluated for renewable energy transition proposals submitted for regional port subsidies is 84 points on a 100-point scale.
PSUS-PORT-W1X：The North Sea Renewable Kerosene Alliance achieved a port clean technology innovation score of 95 points on a 100-point scale regarding its renewable energy transition proposals submitted for regional port subsidies.
